NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

SEP 27 1938

In the Russian Colony
BY "STROY"

An interesting economic survey of the Russian colony has been completed by Commander N. G. Fomin, Chairman of the National Committee. According to data collected, only 10 per cent. of the colony are well-to-do, while at the other extreme 20 per cent. are unemployed. Thus the other 70 per cent., the middle layer that in the Russian colony can be held equivalent to what the French call the "third estate" takes in the overwhelming majority of Russian Shanghailanders.

Unemployment among Russians has a tendency to grow, Commander Fomin reveals. The first impetus in this direction was given by the world economic depression, whose effects were first experienced in the local labour front in 1932. The hectic year of 1937 gave a further jolt to the Russian colony, especially to that not inconsiderable number of its members who lived in Chapei and Nantao. It must be remembered, notes Commander Fomin, that in Shanghai, Russians do not live independently but adapt themselves to the city's foreign and Chinese life, between which circles they try, as it were, to act as mediators and go-betweens. The "third estate," of course, caters also to itself and to that well-to-do part of the colony that finds its embodiment in Russian factories, shops, places of amusement, the medical world, etc. The events of last year reacted painfully on the whole colony. They reacted even on those who earn $500 to $600 a month, as they have been hard hit by the mercurial rise in prices of food, lodging and practically everything else—especially if they have families to provide for.

A Mystery
How Russians earning $50, $70, $100 or $125 a month are able to live under these conditions remains a mystery. All of them, whether with families or not, live in rooms, having long forgotten the comforts of flats; and it can be surmised that far from all have hot meals every day. Into the same category fall the many family-men who work as watchmen, as bodyguards, in the Volunteer Corps, or in the Fire Brigade; and of these the colony has no less than a thousand. An easier time of it is had by families several of whose members—the father, the mother, the grown-up sons or daughters—bring in pay-cheques at the end of every month. Here the budget is balanced with the help of every dollar.

Russian charity is making a major contribution to enable youth to secure positions. In Russian schools a good education can be had for very small fees. Free medical service is given indigent Russians both by the Orthodox Confraternity and by the French authorities. No less than 135,000 free meals were given out last year. And a committee composed of all foreign charity organizations in Shanghai is seeking means of further helping the Russian colony, two thirds of whose population of 20,000 to 25,000 subsist on salaries that no foreigner would deem sufficient for livelihood in Shanghai at the present time.

New Russian Journal
A new Russian newspaper, published in 211 Yangtzepoo Road, has made its appearance in Shanghai. This journal, which will start by coming out as a weekly, is called the "Russkyi Golos" (Russian Voice), and officially terms itself "the organ of the fight against Communism." Its first leading article it promises to "serve the politically active portion of the nationally inclined Russian emigration." The Editor of this new periodical is Mr. N. I. Djogalin.

1938年9月27日

在俄侨聚居区
作者：“STROY”

民族委员会主席 N. G. Fomin 指挥官已完成了一份关于俄侨聚居区的有趣经济调查。根据收集到的数据，该聚居区中仅有10%的人生活富裕，而处于另一极端的则有20%的人失业。因此，其余70%的人构成了中间阶层，在俄侨聚居区中，这一阶层相当于法国人所说的“第三等级”，占据了上海俄籍居民（Shanghailanders）的绝大多数。

Fomin 指挥官透露，俄侨中的失业人数有增长的趋势。这方面的最初推动力来自世界经济大萧条，其影响于1932年首先在当地劳动力市场上显现出来。动荡的1937年给俄侨聚居区带来了进一步的冲击，尤其是对其成员中居住在闸北和南市的那相当数量的人群。Fomin 指挥官指出，必须记住，在上海，俄国人并非独立生活，而是适应这座城市的外国人和中国人的生活，他们试图在这两个圈子之间充当调解人和中间人的角色。当然，“第三等级”也为自身以及聚居区中富裕的那部分人提供服务，这部分人的体现是俄国工厂、商店、娱乐场所、医疗界等。去年的事件对整个聚居区产生了痛苦的影响。甚至对那些月收入500至600美元的人也产生了影响，因为他们受到食品、住宿及几乎其他所有物品价格急剧上涨的重创——尤其是如果他们有需要供养的家庭的话。

一个谜团
在这种条件下，月收入50、70、100或125美元的俄国人如何能够生存，仍然是一个谜。他们所有人，无论是否有家庭，都住在房间里，早已忘记了公寓的舒适；可以推测，远非所有人都能每天吃到热饭。许多有家室的男子也属于同一类别，他们担任看守、保镖、义勇队队员或消防队队员；这类人在聚居区中不少于一千人。那些家庭成员——父亲、母亲、成年的儿子或女儿——每月月底都能带回薪水的家庭，日子会好过一些。在这里，每一美元都对平衡预算有所帮助。

俄国慈善事业在为青年谋取职位方面做出了重大贡献。在俄国学校中，只需很少的费用就能接受良好的教育。正教兄弟会和法国当局都为贫困俄国人提供免费医疗服务。去年发放了不少于135,000份免费餐食。由上海所有外国慈善组织组成的委员会正在寻求进一步帮助俄侨聚居区的方法，该聚居区人口在20,000至25,000之间，其中三分之二的人依靠薪水维持生计，而在目前，任何外国人都会认为这些薪水不足以在上海维持生活。

新的俄文期刊
一家新的俄文报纸已在上海问世，出版地址为杨树浦路211号。这份期刊起初将作为周刊发行，名为《Russkyi Golos》（俄语之声），并正式自称是“反共斗争的机关报”。它承诺其首篇社论将“服务于具有政治活跃性的、倾向民族主义的俄国流亡者群体”。这份新刊物的编辑是 N. I. Djogalin 先生。

In Our Russian Colony
By AN. A. NOGAYTSEFF

Among the numerous Russian newspapers published in Shanghai there is one, the recent appearance of which gave birth to all sorts of rumours and gossips among the Russians.

First of all nobody knows where the said paper, which is titled "The Active", is being published, or where is the address of its office and who is the editor of the paper.

There are many Russians who are willing to subscribe to the paper but nobody knows where to apply and yet the canvassers for subscriptions to "The Active", are very difficult to be found. Regarding the editor of this mysterious paper, there are also different rumours being spread all over the city. M-me Trindina, who describes herself as editor and by which name the paper is signed, is not believed to be a real person. The name is not known to any Russian here and the local Russian newspapermen, who usually know one another, denied that they had ever heard the name.

It is said that the most probable thing is that M-me Trindina just signs the paper, that there is someone else behind her and, even, that there is no M-me Trindina at all, the name being just a nom-de-plume and the paper published by people who are not willing to expose themselves.

"The Active" does not appear regularly; it has only four pages and each page is but a quarter of the ordinary newspaper's size.

Upon becoming acquainted with one or more issues of "The Active", the reader gets the impression that the paper is not satisfied with everything and everyone in Shanghai. There is not a single public concern or private person mentioned by the paper, which is not blamed and accused of something.

We wouldn't mention all this if the paper seemed to be one of these "mosquito papers", which usually print all the rubbish about false sensations in order to have a good street sale and to which, usually, nobody pays any attention.

No, the paper is not after even that small money, it is getting for its sale and we will not be far wrong in stating that the paper doesn't even cover its own printing expenses.

Then it means that some people have to pay the expenses, who, undoubtedly, are the publishers and who, of course, have some definite purpose in spending this money.

The idea of "The Active", as is repeatedly stated in the paper, is anti-communistic.

Every idea has got to be respected by everybody, even by the enemies of the idea, while it is being brought into life correctly.

Although not communists ourselves, we at least, don't agree with the ways "The Active" is employing in its anti-communist campaign.

At any rate "The Active's" people don't act correctly. We willingly admit that many questions mentioned by the paper have got to be brought to light, that there are some injustices, for which our city is famous, which have got to be ended, but we still don't agree that the whole of the Russian Colony or even all the public concerns and private persons, mentioned by the paper are to be blamed for that. We didn't see all the issues of "The Active" published, but even in those few copies, we were given to have a look at, we found several respected persons mentioned who certainly have not deserved all the blame and accusations of "The Active."

Our advice to the publishers of "The Active" is to remember that they represent the Press of the movement they pretend, to be connected with which representation is a most responsible one, and to change the methods of bringing their ideas into life completely, otherwise they will be known as the publishers of a mosquito paper.

在我们的俄侨聚居区
作者：AN. A. NOGAYTSEFF

在上海出版的众多俄文报纸中，有一份报纸最近的出现，在俄国人中间引发了各种谣言和闲话。

首先，没有人知道这份题为《The Active》（行动报）的报纸是在哪里出版的，也不知道其办公室地址在哪里，更不知道谁是该报的编辑。

有许多俄国人愿意订阅该报，但无人知晓去哪里申请，而且《The Active》的征订员也很难找到。关于这份神秘报纸的编辑，全市也流传着不同的谣言。自称编辑并以该名字签署报纸的 Trindina 夫人，被认为不是一个真实存在的人。这里的俄国人都不知道这个名字，当地通常彼此认识的俄国新闻工作者也否认曾听说过这个名字。

据说，最可能的情况是，Trindina 夫人只是在报纸上署名，背后另有其人，甚至根本不存在 Trindina 夫人这个人，这个名字只是一个笔名，报纸是由不愿暴露身份的人出版的。

《The Active》不定期出版；它只有四页，每页的大小仅为普通报纸的四分之一。

在阅读了一期或多期《The Active》后，读者得到的印象是，该报对上海的一切人和事都不满意。该报提到的每一个公共机构或私人，无一不被指责和控告某事。

如果这份报纸看起来像是那些“蚊型小报”之一，我们本不会提及所有这些，这些小报通常刊登所有关于虚假煽情的垃圾内容，以求获得良好的街头销量，而通常没人会注意它们。

不，这份报纸甚至不追求通过销售获得的那点微薄收入，我们可以毫不夸张地说，这份报纸甚至无法覆盖其自身的印刷费用。

这意味着必须有人支付费用，这些人无疑就是出版者，当然，他们在花费这笔钱时有着明确的目的。

正如该报反复声明的那样，《The Active》的理念是反共的。

每一种理念都必须得到每个人的尊重，甚至是该理念的敌人的尊重，只要它是被正确地付诸实践。

虽然我们自己不是共产主义者，但我们至少不同意《The Active》在其反共运动中所采用的方式。

无论如何，《The Active》的人员行事并不正当。我们乐意承认，该报提到的许多问题必须被揭露，我们城市以之闻名的一些不公现象必须终结，但我们仍然不同意将该报提到的整个俄侨聚居区，甚至所有公共机构和私人都归咎于此。我们没有看到《The Active》出版的所有期数，但在给我们看的那几份中，我们发现提到了几位受人尊敬的人士，他们肯定不应承受《The Active》的所有指责和控诉。

我们要建议《The Active》的出版者记住，他们代表着他们声称与之相关的运动的新闻界，这种代表性责任重大，并彻底改变将其理念付诸实践的方法，否则他们将被视为一家蚊型小报的出版者。

1. "Our paper published less than a quarter of the material at the disposal of the editor regarding the evil of theft and uncontrolled spending of public funds collected for charitable purposes"...

2. " We have published enough material concerning the activities of the Russian Emigrants' Committee who betray the interests of Russian emigrants. 在最近的敌对行动期间，利扎拉加重新出现在上海，并靠其俄罗斯妻子的收入生活了一段时间；其妻过去十年一直从事‘按摩’行业，供养丈夫并为支付律师费提供资金。

谁能想到，目前这个小骗子利扎拉加在上海的外资银行里有二十五万美元。此外，他还拥有几块土地、两套公寓、汽车，并且还有一个保险箱，里面存放着价值45,000美元的钻石以备不时之需。

目前，利扎拉加已建立了一定的关系网。他雇佣能干的律师。他甚至认识P先生——警界的一位大人物。榆林路警署的H巡长和虹口警署的M巡长不仅从他那里收到成箱的啤酒和威士忌，而且赚取的金额甚至是其服役25年后退休金的两倍。

    Well, Mr. Beloshenko, all that you have read above is not
a fancy, but facts courteously put at your disposal by the editor
of the "Activ". For more detailed information on this subject
you can apply to the Japanese Military Police, Bridge House, near

    Towards the end of May last a Russian driver was arrest-

"Evening Post", but at the very last moment the "machinery was
properly oiled". The article did not appear and the scandal was
hushed up.

    The ingenuity of this fellow has the quality of a genius.
At present he engages Chinese owned motor trucks, puts Russian
drivers in charge of them and through the medium of a certain
Spaniard named Sanchos loots factories and godowns. In the event
a Russian driver is arrested or a truck is detained- Lizaraga
is not responsible.

    We know that the new inspector in Hongkew, Mr. Robertson,

    好吧，别洛申科先生，你上面读到的不是幻想，而是《活跃报》编辑恭敬地提供给你的事实。关于此主题的更详细信息，你可以咨询位于桥附近的桥屋（Bridge House）的日本宪兵队。几天前，你自己就是虹口警署类似案件的目击者

    去年五月底，一名俄国司机在韦斯特区（Wayside，音译）被捕。他声称财产属于利扎拉加。后者被传唤，但随后被释放。甚至当他和一名中国人一起出现在外滩接收一批鸦片时，他也被释放了。有人就此主题为《晚邮报》（Evening Post）撰写了一篇文章，但在最后一刻，‘机器得到了适当的润滑’。文章未发表，丑闻被平息。

    这个家伙的机智具有天才的品质。目前，他租用华人拥有的卡车，让俄国司机负责驾驶，并通过一个名叫桑乔斯（Sanchos，音译）的西班牙人作为中介，洗劫工厂和仓库。如果俄国司机被捕或卡车被扣留，利扎拉加概不负责。

    We now will tell how Lizaraga has made his money. He
removed furniture from the house owned by a Chinese millionaire
named Hu, as well as the curios from his house situated near the
Country Club. He removed from the godowns of the Nanyang Tobac-

thousands, using a pass of the Universal Leaf Tobacco Company. It
is true that there was a priest ( incredible, isn't it?) behind him
at that time, but not a Russian priest. He has managed to re-
move tobacco of the Hwa Shing Company, cotton from the Sung Sing
Company's godown No 7. This cotton was placed on junks from the
Whashing Road Jetty. From Whashing Road factories No 1 and 2 he
removed motors and chains etc. From the factory of the Great
Eastern Tobacco Company, 769 Kungping Road, which had been damaged
by fire, he removed a boiler on two trucks and one handcart. He
got $22.000 for this boiler. Using a false pass he removed from
the same factory all machinery, which subsequently was sold to
other people. From Dalny, Tongshan and Yulin Roads he removed pro-
perty worth millions of dollars without the knowledge of owners.

    There is a Russian named Volodia who lives at the Wa-
ter Works in Yangtsepoo Road. He worked for Lizaraga for a long
time and can furnish much information of interest not only regard-
ing the looting, but also regarding the connections Lizaraga estab-
lished with certain persons vested with authority and keeping a
watch on Russian looters.

对利扎拉加的活动非常感兴趣。因此，我们恳请你，别洛申科先生，将这篇文章翻译给罗伯逊先生。通过这样做，你可以扬名立万，不是通过逮捕贫困的俄国人，而是通过对付劫掠者之王的大案。

    现在我们将讲述利扎拉加是如何赚钱的。他从一位姓胡的中国百万富翁拥有的房屋中搬走了家具，以及从其位于乡村俱乐部（Country Club）附近的房屋中搬走了古玩。他使用环球烟草公司（Universal Leaf Tobacco Company）的通行证，从南洋兄弟烟草公司的仓库中搬走了价值数十万的烟草、香烟和铁皮。确实，当时背后有一位神父（难以置信，不是吗？）支持他，但不是俄国神父。他还设法搬走了华成烟草公司的烟草，以及从盛兴公司（Sung Sing Company，音译）7号仓库搬走了棉花。这些棉花被装上从华盛路码头（Whashing Road Jetty，音译，应为华盛路）出发的舢板。他从华盛路1号和2号工厂搬走了马达和链条等。从位于公平路769号、遭火灾损坏的大东烟草公司工厂，他用两辆卡车和一辆手推车搬走了一台锅炉。他为此锅炉获得了22,000美元。他使用伪造的通行证从同一家工厂搬走了所有机器，随后卖给了其他人。他从大连路、通山路和榆林路搬走了价值数百万美元的财产，而业主毫不知情。

    有一个名叫沃洛佳（Volodia，音译）的俄国人住在杨树浦路的水厂。他为利扎拉加工作了很长时间，可以提供许多有趣的信息，不仅关于劫掠，还关于利扎拉加与某些掌权人物建立的联系，以及这些人对俄国劫掠者的监视。

munists and partisans.

cerning Druz. It seemed unlikely that a card sharper like Labu-

most active Chinese agents. Being an informer of the Chinese
communists who maintained contact with agents of the Kuomintang

据说位于汉密尔顿大厦（Hamilton House）的军火商行。在过去五年里，这家公司向所谓的中华苏维埃政府供应武器。该公司的所有者仍在中国，据我们要消息，他们继续向中国游击队和共产党人供应武器。该公司拥有广泛的国际联系。它由一名丹麦人和两名俄罗斯人领导。后者一人持有美国护照，另一人持有法国护照。这些人按照莫斯科的指示行事，资助了
中国红军，并在其指导下实施了在西安府扣押蒋介石的行动。其中一人直到最近还居住在四川，并在上海战事开始时匆忙抵达此地。该公司在巴黎、北平和香港设有代表。

很长一段时间以来，我们无法理解拉布京是如何与中国共产党人建立联系的。直到最近，我们才得知拉布京的女儿，“上海的犹太女王”，曾与该辛迪加的一名头目同居。后来她被此人抛弃。正是通过他的女儿，拉布京获得了一套豪华公寓，并开始了一场大赌局，将职业赌徒的活动转变为受雇于上述辛迪加的线人活动。在他女儿的恋情结束后，拉布京切断了与军火辛迪加的联系，但一直保持着与中国共产党人的接触。”

文章中还谴责了一名有犯罪记录的叫多姆布罗夫斯基（Dombrovsky）的人，指控他在最近的上海战事期间从事反日活动。据说他在离开上海很长一段时间后，几天前重新出现在上海。

Subject the "Activ", unregistered Russian weekly publication - issue No 8.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford I.J

Number 8 of the "Activ" appeared on May 21, 1938. In an editorial note it is stated that owing to lack of means the newspaper failed to appear in due time and that in future it will be published two-three times a month. All those who sympathise with this publication are requested to assist in the matter of increasing its circulation. Batoorin, who is believed to be the editor of the "Activ", is alleged to have stated privately that with 500 subscribers its publication can be carried without a hitch.

In addition to critical remarks concerning the Municipal authorities and certain Russian public organizations, the issue under review contains articles of a strongly anti-Semitic character. One of the articles contains a passage concerning the attitude of the Japanese authorities in Manchuria towards Russian emigrants, which is in a discord with the generally pro-Japanese tendencies of this newspaper.

Underneath is a translation of extracts from articles of interest:

1. Article entitled " Looters or starving people?"
Contains criticism of the Municipal Police in connection with the numerous arrests of Russians in the area North of the creek on charges of looting.

" Those who, thanks to the efforts of the Police, are tried on charges of looting ought to be tried only for that they have nothing to eat. The Municipal Police deal with these crimes, but do not wish to find out their causes. The Municipal Authorities ought to understand that petty offences of "looting" perpetrated by Russians are a result of the increasing unemployment. From the formal view point, one half of the Russian community should be incarcerated in order to prevent crimes caused by star-

除了对工部局当局和某些俄罗斯公共组织的批评言论外，本期还包含具有强烈反犹性质的文章。其中一篇文章包含一段关于满洲日本当局对俄罗斯侨民态度的内容，这与该报普遍的亲日倾向不符。

“那些多亏警察努力而以抢劫罪名受审的人，应该仅仅因为他们没有东西吃而受审。工部局警务处处理这些罪行，但不愿查明其原因。工部局当局应当明白，俄罗斯人犯下的轻微‘抢劫’罪是失业率不断上升的结果。从形式上看，为了防止因饥饿引起的犯罪，一半的俄罗斯社区成员都应该被监禁。

With the exception of the complaint received by
the French Police from the proprietors of nine stores situated
in the French Concession about the appeal of the "Activ" for
boycotting them, there is nothing new in the file attached to
the communication dated April 29, 1938 from the French Police.

Forwarded herewith is a summary of information on
file regarding the publication in question, including full trans-
lations of articles referred to by the above complainants.

Appeals for boycotting Soviet goods, Soviet owned
enterprises and those who advertise in Soviet press have been
made in anonymous leaflets which appear in Shanghai from time
to time. So far it cannot be definitely proved who the person
responsible for the publishing and distribution of the "Activ"
is and, therefore, it comes within the category of anonymous
publications. Translation of an article from the Soviet news-
paper "Novosti Dnia" (Russian Daily News) attached under
Appendix "B" shows that the Soviet section of the local Russian
community also resorts to boycott as a means of bringing
pressure to bear on their political opponents.

It is reported that the "Activ" has a very limited
circulation and that it is distributed surreptitiously or by
post both in the Settlement and French Concession.

（批：DBC 4/5）

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

pages.en:
Summary of information regarding the "Activ," unregistered
weekly publication in the Russian language.

The "Activ," "a weekly Russian newspaper devoted
to the White Movement" made its first appearance on March 26,
1938 and up to the present 6 numbers of this paper have been
published. On the front page of the newspaper it is stated that
it is published and edited by one Mrs. V.P. Tryndin, but the
addresses of the editorial and printing offices are omitted. In
the first issue the following temporary address was given for
communication with the editor: "Speed Studio," P.O. Box 4039,
Shanghai."

Enquiries at 720-"C" Avenue Foch, the last known
address of the "Speed Studio," show that a few days prior to the
appearance of the publication in question all printing presses
belonging to this establishment were removed from the premises,
allegedly, to some place in Pootung. Efforts to locate Mrs.
V.P. Tryndin, the supposed editor and publisher, have so far been
unsuccessful, and it seems that there is no such person in Shang-
hai. Information from various sources indicates that in March
last C.V. Batoorin, Russian, proprietor or principal partner of
the "Speed Studio," approached certain persons for the loan of a
small sum in order to have his printing presses removed to another
address. It is also reliably reported that he made an un-
successful attempt to obtain a subsidy from the local Japanese
authorities for the publication of an anti-communist and pro-
Japanese newspaper. Furthermore, the small type used in the
printing of the "Activ" is identical with one of the types in the
use of the "Speed Studio." Batoorin is also known to have
offered for sale copies of this newspaper to several persons both
in the Settlement and French Concession. Therefore, there seems
to be little room for doubt that the "Activ" is published by
Batoorin and is printed at some place located, most likely, in
the Japanese controlled area.
pages.zh:
关于未注册俄文周刊《Activ》的信息摘要。

《Activ》是一份“致力于白俄运动的俄文周报”，于1938年3月26日首次问世，截至目前已出版6期。报纸头版声明由一位 V.P. Tryndin 女士出版和编辑，但未列出编辑部及印刷所的地址。第一期给出了一个用于与编辑联系的临时地址：“Speed Studio”，上海邮政信箱4039号。”

对福煦路720号“Speed Studio”最后已知地址的调查表明，在该刊物出现前几天，该机构所有的印刷机都被搬离了 premises，据称搬往浦东某地。寻找假定编辑兼出版人 V.P. Tryndin 女士的努力至今未果，似乎上海并无此人。来自多方渠道的信息表明，去年三月，“Speed Studio”的所有者或主要合伙人、俄国人 C.V. Batoorin 曾向某些人借款一小笔款项，以便将其印刷机搬迁至另一地址。另有可靠消息 reported，他曾试图从当地日本当局获得资助，以出版一份反共亲日的报纸，但未获成功。此外，《Activ》印刷所用的小号字体与“Speed Studio”使用的其中一种字体完全相同。据悉，Batoorin 还向公共租界和法租界的数人兜售该报纸。因此，几乎可以毫无疑问地认为，《Activ》由 Batoorin 出版，并且很可能是在日本控制区内的某地印刷的。

pages.en:
-2-

No application was received from the editor of the
"Activ" for registration of his newspaper. Moreover, it is clear
from articles published by him that he strongly objects to this
procedure maintaining, inter alia, that it is not necessary to
register with the Municipal Police a newspaper published " out-
side Shanghai".

From the first issue the absolutely irresponsible charac-
ter of this anonymous publication has become apparent. Posing as
a champion of the "White Movement" the object of which is doubt-
ful, the editor of the "Activ" attacks the authorities of the
International Settlement and French Concession, especially the
latter, alleging that they persecute Russian nationalists and ac-
cord protection to communists. He attacks local Soviet authorities
and citizens and at the same time publishes articles, full of
falsehood and malice, concerning public organizations and certain
individual members of the local White Russian community. Some of
his attacks definitely savour of personal spite. Among other
things, the paper contains a couple of articles in which detectives
of the Municipal Police are openly accused of having "framed up"
G. Ushakoff, a Russian, who was sentenced to a term of imprisonment
on a charge of possession of arms and explosives.

No Russian political group or organization is known to
be behind the "Activ" which, it would appear, caters for the scan-
dal mongering sector of the Russian community and seeks to win
the favour of the Japanese authorities. The publication has arouse
ed much adverse comment in all responsible circles of the local
Russian community.

Translations of a series of articles from the "Activ"
are on file and give a general idea of the low character of this
publication.
pages.zh:
-2-

《Activ》的编辑未提交其报纸的注册申请。此外，从他发表的文章中可以清楚地看出，他强烈反对这一程序，并坚称，在“上海以外”出版的报纸无需向工部局警务处注册。

从第一期开始，这份匿名出版物极其不负责任的性质便显露无遗。《Activ》的编辑自诩为“白俄运动”的捍卫者，尽管该运动的目标令人怀疑，他攻击国际公共租界和法租界的当局，尤其是后者，指控他们迫害俄罗斯民族主义者并庇护共产党人。他攻击当地的苏联当局和公民，同时发表充满谎言和恶意的文章，针对当地白俄社区的公共组织和某些个人成员。他的一些攻击明显带有个人报复的色彩。其中包括几篇文章，公然指责工部局警务处的侦探“构陷”了一名俄国人 G. Ushakoff，后者因持有武器和爆炸物罪被判处监禁。

目前没有已知的俄罗斯政治团体或组织在背后支持《Activ》，该刊物似乎迎合了俄侨社区中喜好散布丑闻的那部分人群，并试图赢得日本当局的好感。该出版物在当地俄侨社区的所有负责任阶层中引起了诸多负面评论。

《Activ》一系列文章的译文已存档，可大致了解该刊物的低劣性质。

DO NOT GIVE YOUR MONEY TO BOLSHEVIKS

Many Russian emigrants deliberately or through ignorance sup-
port by their money the existence and activities of the fo-
reign section of the Comintern. By the purchasing of Soviet
goods, by the patronizing Soviet commercial enterprises, white
Russian emigrants aggravate the conditions of forced labour
in the U.S.S.R. and strengthen the Soviet commercial and po-
litical influence. In the same way emigrants contribute to-
wards the maintenance of Soviet agents-provocateurs in their
own midst. All Russian emigrants should unanimously boycott
Soviet goods and stores. Emigrants should spend their hard
earned money in enterprises owned by emigrants or by those
who support the Russian cause. There must be no excuses when
the struggle against the red contagion is concerned. Boycott
Soviet citizens, members of the Repatriation Union ,boycott
all those who assit them. Persuade your friends to participate

许多俄国移民故意或因无知，用他们的金钱支持共产国际外国部的存在和活动。通过购买苏联商品、光顾苏联商业企业，白俄移民加剧了苏联境内的强迫劳动状况，并加强了苏联的商业和政治影响力。同样，移民们也有助于维持潜伏在他们中间的苏联代理人-挑衅者。所有俄国移民应一致抵制苏联商品和商店。移民应将辛苦赚来的钱花在由移民拥有或由支持俄罗斯事业的人拥有的企业中。在对抗红色传染病的斗争中，没有任何借口可言。抵制苏联公民、归国联盟成员，抵制所有协助他们的人。说服你的朋友参与抵制，对每个人说：“不与我们站在一起的人——就是反对我们”。

Appendix "B"

Translation from Russian newspaper "NOVOSTI DNIA", February 15,
1937. Published by the "Russian Publishing Co", 620 Avenue
Foch. Editor - Mr. A. I. Weiss.

SOVIET COMMUNITY IN SHANGHAI BEGINS TO BOYCOTT
THOSE WHO SUPPORT JOURNALISTS INSTIGATING POG-
ROMS.

As a protest against certain periodicals of the
"pogrom" kind existing in this city, the Soviet community
in Shanghai has decided to boycott not the periodicals
themselves, which have a very limited circulation, but those
commercial firms which advertise in these dirty publica-
tions. Strictly speaking, the firms giving advertisements
to "pogrom-makers" become accessories to the pogrom cam-
paign which has been transferred here from Harbin and be-
gins to thrive on the free soil of Shanghai.

This is a very sensible measure and, taking into
consideration the buying capacity of the local Soviet com-
munity, - also a very effective one. Firms and shops
which will continue to advertise in "pogrom" publications
will feel the consequences of this boycott.

上海苏联社区开始抵制支持煽动大屠杀记者的人。

作为对本市存在的某些“大屠杀”类期刊的抗议，上海苏联社区决定抵制的不是这些发行量非常有限的期刊本身，而是在这些肮脏出版物上刊登广告的商业公司。严格来说，向“大屠杀制造者”提供广告的公司成为了从哈尔滨转移至此并开始在上海这片自由土地上蓬勃发展的“大屠杀”运动的帮凶。

这是一项非常明智的措施，考虑到当地苏联社区的购买力，也是一项非常有效的措施。继续在“大屠杀”类出版物上刊登广告的公司和商店将感受到此次抵制的后果。

Shanghai, April 29,1938

Major F.W. Gerrard
Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI

Sir,

I have the honour to forward herewith a file concerning
the "ACTIV",a publication in the Russian language,which is believed
to have been originally printed by C.V.Batoorin's "Speed Studio",
720 Avenue Foch.

In all the numbers that have appeared up to the present,
this publication has contained articles against the local foreign
authorities and especially against the French Authorities.

It also contains a list of stores located in the two
concessions and an appeal for the boycotting of them.

Proprietors of nine stores in the French Concession
have written to the Police complaining about this appeal for boy-
cotting them,which constitutes an infringement of Art.313 of the
C.C.R.C.

In bringing these facts to your notice I have to ask
you,should you deem it necessary, to have proceedings instituted
against the persons responsible and in the meantime to ban the sale
of the "Activ" in the Settlement. This publication is banned in the
French Concession.

I am,Sir,etc......

(Signed) L.Fabre
Directeur des Services de Police.

谨此转交一份关于《ACTIV》的档案，这是一份俄文出版物，据信最初由 C.V. Batoorin 的“Speed Studio”印刷，地址为福煦路720号。

在迄今为止出版的所有期数中，该出版物均包含针对当地外国当局，特别是针对法国当局的 articles。

现将上述事实提请阁下注意，如阁下认为必要，请对责任人提起诉讼，同时禁止在公共租界内销售《Activ》。该出版物已在法租界被禁。

敬礼 ____ 

（签名）L. Fabre
警务处处长。

Shanghai, le 7 Avril 193 8.

RAPPORT

Objet : "L'Action", journal russe de caractère fasciste.

No. 1592/2. -
=
Référ : rapport n°1589/2 du 29 mars 1938.
C. BATOUKINE.

Le No.2 du journal russe de caractère fasciste, intitulé
"L'Action", qui a fait l'objet de notre rapport N°1589/2, est
paru le 2 avril. Comme le No.1, il a été distribué par la
poste; mais il semble qu'il en ait été tiré moins d'exemplai-
res, car il est à peu près introuvable en ville.

Il serait faux cependant, à l'encontre de ce qui est an-
noncé en première page du journal, que l'imprimerie "Speed
Studio" ait refusé depuis le 28 mars d'en assurer la distri-
bution. Le matériel de cette imprimerie qui se trouvait au
N°720 B, avenue Foch a été transporté à une adresse inconnue
quelques jours avant la publication du premier numéro. Notre
enquête à ce sujet continue et des renseignements complémen-
taires seront donnés prochainement.

Le contenu général du N°2 de "L'Action" est similaire
à celui du No.1. Plusieurs articles attaquent les autorités
des Concessions de la place que le journal accuse d'opprimer
les émigrés russes et de favoriser la propagande soviétique.
Traduction intégrale de ces articles est donnée ci-joint. Les
organisations des émigrés russes, que "L'Action" considère com-
me dirigées contre les intérêts des Russes sont aussi criti-
quées.

s/H.B.
P.de B.
L.A./V.F.

（印：SERVICE POLITIQUE
Enregistré le 13 APR 1938
Sous No. 21576
Transmis à [签名]
Pour C/）

警务处
政治部

上海，1938年4月7日。

报告

事由：“L'Action”（行动），一份具有法西斯性质的俄文报纸。

编号 1592/2. -
=
参考：1938年3月29日第1589/2号报告。
C. BATOUKINE。

具有法西斯性质的俄文报纸《L'Action》（行动）第2期已于4月2日出版，该报是我们第1589/2号报告的主题。与第1期一样，它是通过邮政分发的；但似乎印数较少，因为在市内几乎找不到。

然而，与报纸头版宣布的内容相反，声称“Speed Studio”印刷所自3月28日起拒绝负责其分发是不实的。该印刷所位于霞飞路720 B号的设备在第一期出版前几天已被转移到一个未知的地址。我们对此的调查仍在继续，补充信息将在不久后提供。

《L'Action》第2期的总体内容与第1期相似。多篇文章攻击租界当局，指责该报压迫俄国侨民并 favore 苏联宣传。这些文章的完整译文附后。《L'Action》认为针对俄国利益的俄国侨民组织也受到了批评。

s/H.B.
P.de B.
L.A./V.F.

（印章：政治部
登记于 1938年4月13日
编号 21576
转交 [签名]
供抄送/）

pages.en:
1592/2 - p.2.

Ci-après un sommaire succinct de ce numéro :

1. Article attirant l'attention du public sur le tra-
vail du G.P.U. dirigé contre la presse "blanche". Il est
dit entre autre dans cet article :
"... La presse "blanche" est une arme trop puissante,
pour que les bolcheviques puissent admettre son existence.
Ils tâchent de l'exterminer par tous les moyens. Mais les
"blancs" sont capables de soutenir la lutte et prêts à com-
bler les pertes. La revue "Parous" a été remplacée par la
"Groza". Cette dernière par "L'action". Le drapeau de la pres-
se "blanche" est toujours levé plus haut au moment où il sem-
ble tomber... La lutte n'est point terminée. Elle ne cessera
qu'à la chute du Komintern. Le communisme doit mourir - la
Russie jamais! Voilà le mot d'ordre qui doit inspirer tous
les Russes (p.1).

2. Mot d'ordre : "Aucun droit ne peut être placé au-
dessus de la vérité" (p.1).

3. Article consacré à l'affaire GOSPOFF et dirigé con-
tre les autorités de la Police Française. Traduction inté-
grale de cet article est donnée ci-joint (p.1) (voir Annexe :

4. Article sur les passeports délivrés aux Russes par
le Bureau du Gouvernement "Ta Tao". L'auteur accuse le comité
des émigrés de profiter de la nécessité pour les russes de se
faire enregistrer auprès de ses bureaux, pour prélever à son
profit 1 dollar 50 de frais d'enregistrement par personne.
Ainsi le coût d'un certificat d'identité délivré par le gou-
vernement "Ta Tao" est doublé (p.1).

5. Article disant que tandis que le gouvernement "Ta Tao"
exige l'enregistrement des émigrés russes, les Cours chinoi-
ses installées dans les Concessions Etrangères ne reconnais-
pages.zh:
1592/2 - 第2页。

以下是本期内容的简要摘要：

1. 一篇文章引起公众对格别乌（G.P.U.）针对“白俄”新闻界工作的注意。文章中提到：
“...‘白俄’新闻界是一种过于强大的武器，布尔什维克不能容忍其存在。他们试图通过各种手段将其消灭。但‘白俄’有能力支持这场斗争并准备弥补损失。《Parous》杂志已被《Groza》取代。后者又被《L'action》取代。‘白俄’新闻界的旗帜在看似跌落之时反而升得更高... 斗争并未结束。只有当共产国际垮台时，它才会停止。共产主义必须灭亡——俄罗斯永存！这就是应该激励所有俄国人的口号（第1页）。

2. 口号：“任何权利都不能置于真理之上”（第1页）。

3. 一篇专门讨论 GOSPOFF 案件并针对法国警察当局的文章。该文章的完整译文附后（第1页）（见附件：

4. 一篇关于“大陶”政府局向俄国人发放护照的文章。作者指责侨民委员会利用俄国人必须在其办事处登记的必要性，每人收取1.50美元的登记费以牟利。因此，“大陶”政府颁发的身份证明书的成本增加了一倍（第1页）。

5. 一篇文章称，虽然“大陶”政府要求俄国侨民登记，但设在外国租界内的中国法院并不承认

pages.en:
1392/2 - 3.

sent pas la validité de ces documents. Ils ne sont pas reconnus non plus par la police. C'est pourquoi les Russes qui travaillent activement contre le Komintern, sont sans défense.
Cette situation est intolérable déclare l'auteur. Les Cours doivent passer sous la juridiction du nouveau pouvoir. Toutes les poursuites dirigées contre les forces anti-communistes et particulièrement celles intentées dans le Settlement contre le journal "L'Action doivent cesser (p.1).

6. Note (tirée d'un journal russe de Paris) donnant quelques détails sur l'assassinat à Paris, dans des circonstances mystérieuses d'un chauffeur russe qui aurait été en possession de documents relatifs à l'enlèvement du général Miller (p.1).

7. Extrait de l'article paru le 18 février 1938 dans le journal "Vojrojdenie Asii" de Tientsin comparant la situation des Russes sur la Concession Française de Shanghai à celle des juifs dans les "ghetto" (p.1)(cf.Rapport No2542/S du 16 mars 1938).

8. Article accusant la Police du Settlement de favoriser l'Union des Emigrés Russes désireux de rentrer en URSS. Elle ne serait en réalité qu'une filiale du G.P.U. La traduction de cet article est donnée ci-joint (v.annexe II) (p.2).

9. Récit de quelques incidents ridicules de la vie en URSS (p.2,3).

10. Article accusant le Comité des Emigrés Russes de Shanghai de procédés bureaucratiques et insistant sur la nécessité de sa réorganisation (p.3).

11. Article accusant les Mladorossy (Jeunes Russes) de se livrer à un travail de provocation (p.3).
pages.zh:
1392/2 - 3.

并未承认这些文件的有效性。警方也不予承认。因此，那些积极从事反共产国际工作的俄国人处于毫无防备的境地。
作者宣称，这种状况是不可容忍的。法院必须置于新权力的管辖之下。所有针对反共力量的起诉，特别是那些在租界内针对《行动报》（L'Action）提起的诉讼，必须停止（第1页）。

6. 笔记（摘自巴黎的一份俄文报纸），提供了一些细节，关于一名俄国司机在巴黎神秘情况下被暗杀的事件，该司机据称持有与米勒将军绑架案有关的文件（第1页）。

7. 摘录自1938年2月18日天津《亚洲复兴报》（Vojrojdenie Asii）刊登的文章，将上海法租界内俄国人的处境与“隔都”中的犹太人处境进行比较（第1页）（参见1938年3月16日的第2542/S号报告）。

8. 一篇文章指责公共租界警务处偏袒希望返回苏联的“俄国侨民联盟”。文章称该联盟实际上只是国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）的一个分支机构。该文章的译文附后（见附件二）（第2页）。

En voici la traduction :

"Dès la publication du premier numéro de "L'Action", les
"employés blancs" de la Police se sont lancés à la recherche
de notre imprimerie et de notre bureau de rédaction. Une pres-
sion a été exercée sur le "Speed Studio" qui s'était chargé de

à Shanghai a été considérée comme une action illégale, tandis
que toutes les publications soviétiques et pro-soviétiques sont
vendues ouvertement. La rédaction et l'imprimerie se trouvent
en dehors du Settlement et de la Concession Française. Aucun

Où est GOUSTOFF.

Dans des circonstances similaires à celles de l'enlèvement
des généraux KOUTEPOFF et MILLER, a été enlevé à Shanghai le 9
février le patriote et journaliste russe D.I. GOUSTOFF. L'enlè-
vement fut exécuté avec l'approbation du Consul Général de France.
Les instigateurs de ce crime infâme sont : le chef du Service
Politique de la Police Française, SALLY et son adjoint, un ancien
officier russe SLIANOFF. D'après les informations récemment
obtenues, D.I. GOUSTOFF fut expulsé à bord d'un vapeur grec à
destination de Wenchow où il a été remis aux Autorités Chinoises.
Les autorités locales ont immédiatement mis GOUSTOFF en état
d'arrestation et l'ont jeté en prison sans qu'aucun chef d'accu-
sation puisse être relevé contre lui. Quelques jours plus tard,
il fut transféré à l'intérieur de la Chine par ordre de l'état-
major des troupes communistes chinoises. Depuis ce moment, on a
perdu sa trace.

古斯托夫（GOUSTOFF）在哪里。

在与库捷波夫（KOUTEPOFF）将军和米勒（MILLER）将军被绑架类似的情况下，俄国爱国者兼记者 D.I. 古斯托夫（D.I. GOUSTOFF）于2月9日在上海被绑架。此次绑架是在法国总领事的认可下执行的。这起卑鄙罪行的煽动者是：法国警务处政治部主任萨利（SALLY）及其副手、前俄国军官斯利亚诺夫（SLIANOFF）。根据最近获得的情报，D.I. 古斯托夫被驱逐登上一艘前往温州的希腊轮船，并在那里被移交给中国当局。地方当局立即逮捕了古斯托夫并将其投入监狱，尽管对他提不出任何指控。几天后，根据中国共产党军队参谋部的命令，他被转移至中国内地。从那时起，便失去了他的踪迹。

pages.en:
Annexe N°I - p.2

En réponse à l'indignation générale que cet acte illégal
de la Police Française a soulevé dans les milieux de l'émigra-
tion russe, certaines personnes ont fait connaître à la presse
que des démarches ont été faites pour libérer GOSTOFF et le
faire revenir à Shanghai.

L'avocat français Paul P...T qui s'est chargé contre des
honoraires très respectables de la défense de l'expulsé, n'a
rien fait jusqu'à présent en sa faveur. Cette inertie est d'au-
tant plus étrange qu'en plus de sa responsabilité envers ses
clients qui lui ont confié cette affaire, Paul P...T est morale-
ment responsable envers GOSTOFF. En effet, c'est lui-même qui a
conseillé à GOSTOFF de revenir sur la Concession française, per-
mettant ainsi à ses ravisseurs d'accomplir leur acte infâme.
L'émigration russe, particulièrement révoltée par l'action de
la Police française et par le rôle provocateur et l'inaction de
l'avocat français, attend que cette affaire soit rendue publique.
La colonie russe doit savoir : où se trouve actuellement M.
GOSTOFF, dans quelles conditions il est détenu, les raisons pour
lesquelles il a été enlevé par la police française et quelles
mesures ont été prises en vue de lui assurer la vie sauve. La
colonie russe veut savoir si l'enlèvement des émigrés russes est
légal sur la Concession française ou bien si les personnes impli-
quées dans l'enlèvement de GOSTOFF seront punies.
pages.zh:
附件一 - 第2页

为了回应法国警方的这一非法行为在俄国侨民阶层中引发的普遍愤慨，一些人向媒体透露，已采取行动以释放古斯托夫（GOSTOFF）并使其返回上海。

法国律师保罗·P...T（Paul P...T）收取了高额费用，负责为被驱逐者辩护，但迄今为止未为其做任何事情。这种不作为尤为奇怪，因为除了对委托此案的客户的责任外，保罗·P...T 在道德上对古斯托夫也负有责任。事实上，正是他建议古斯托夫返回法租界，从而使其绑架者得以实施这一卑鄙行径。俄国侨民对法国警方的行动以及该法国律师的挑衅角色和不作为感到特别愤怒，期待此事公之于众。俄国侨民社群必须知道：古斯托夫先生目前身在何处，他被拘禁的条件如何，他被法国警方绑架的原因是什么，以及采取了哪些措施来确保他的生命安全。俄国侨民社群想知道，在法租界绑架俄国侨民是否合法，或者参与绑架古斯托夫的人员是否会受到惩罚。

l'émigration russe et d'exercer sur elle une pression. L'Union
des émigrés russes désireux de rentrer en URSS existait déjà,
depuis plusieurs années, à Paris. La majorité des membres de
l'Union sont, pour la plupart des émigrés déclassés et sans prin-
cipe, qui s'affilient à cette organisation pour toucher de petites
subventions et la jeunesse russe, qui n'a pas connu la vieille
Russie et qu'une propagande habile a fait croire aux succès rem-
portés par le gouvernement soviétique. De nombreux émigrés ont
adhéré à l'Union après avoir fait partie du "deuxième parti so-
viétique" - "Mladorossy" (1). Evoluant, ces "Mladorossy", ne se
rappelant de leur mot d'ordre, "le Tsar et les Soviets", que le
mot "Soviet" auquel l'époque des choses ajoute "et le G.P.U.". Les
émigrés russes savaient depuis longtemps déjà que l'Union des émi-
grés russes désireux de rentrer en URSS est l'un des centres d'es-
pionnage soviétique. A la suite de l'enlèvement du général MILLER,
ce fait a dû être connu même de la Police française, aveugle jus-
qu'alors. Deux perquisitions au siège de l'Union à Paris et l'ar-
restation de ses dirigeants ont prouvé au gouvernement français,
allié de l'URSS, que l'Union faisait fonction de section du G.P.U.
Les membres de l'Union ont été impliqués dans l'affaire de l'as-
sassinat du nommé KISS, Tchékiste qui avait rompu avec les so-
viets, ainsi que dans l'affaire de l'enlèvement du général MILLER.
Comme celle de Paris, l'Union des émigrés russes désireux de ren-
trer de Shanghai en URSS travaille pour le Komintern. Le camarade
V.N. KONSTANTINOV, attaché militaire des Soviets, qui dirige le
service d'espionnage militaire et M.G. JEFFERY, secrétaire du
consulat des Soviets, qui reçoit les demandes des émigrés désireux

dont l'organe central est à Paris, préconisent la défense du ter-
ritoire de l'URSS contre toute intervention étrangère et le réta-
blissement du régime monarchique, tout en conservant les soviets,
comme organes administratifs locaux.

de THILITIN, ancien forçat, condamné à une peine d'emprisonnement
à Harbine pour meurtre. Ce criminel joue à l'Union le rôle d'ins-
tructeur politique pour la préparation de nouveaux cadres soviéti-
ques. Sont également membres de l'Union le capitaine JAKIEFF, bien
connu pour ses atrocités lorsqu'il faisait partie du détachement
du Baron UNGERN, V.V. BOUKHAROFF et V.A. MYBALOFF, anciens collabora-
teurs des journaux "Shanghai Zaria" et "Slovo". Comme toutes les
organisations soviétiques, l'Union possède une "section des fem-
mes" qui organise ces soirées dansantes. Il est intéressant de
noter que l'un des premiers articles des statuts de l'Union stipu-
le la subordination stricte de ses membres à l'exécutif sans dis-
cussion par eux de tous les ordres de ses dirigeants. Cet article
révèle bien le caractère "Tchekiste" de cette organisation. L'un
des membres du comité de l'Union n'a-t-il pas dit, "le G.P.U.
possède plus de deux cents agents secrets qu'il ne paye pas". Ces
agents travaillent dans de nombreuses organisations russes et
étrangères de Shanghai. La majorité des membres de l'Union ont
reçu l'ordre de ne pas divulguer leur affiliation à cette organisa-
tion. Ils sont tenus de participer aux activités des organisations

成为苏联公民者，是该联盟的非官方保护者。该联盟由斯维宁先生（M. SVININ，又名SVININE）领导，他最近编辑了一份卑劣的刊物，并发起了一场针对白俄移民的可耻诽谤运动。大家都记得斯维宁对K.E.马卡罗夫（K.E. MAKAROV）的攻击，法院对此进行了审理并判处其罚款。联盟的其他领导人包括：切尔戈夫先生（M. TCHERGOV），他曾作为“青年俄罗斯人”（Mladorossy）的编辑为其报纸《新路》（Novy Put）工作；A.L.康斯坦丁诺夫（A.L. KONSTANTINOV），前法租界华伦路（route Vallon）一家商店的店主，也是某个浸信会教派的成员；以及N.F.普奇科夫（N.F. POUTCHKOFF），蒂利廷（THILITIN）的同事，前苦役犯，曾因谋杀罪在哈尔滨被判监禁。这名罪犯在联盟中担任政治教官，负责培训新的苏维埃干部。联盟的成员还包括雅基耶夫上尉（capitaine JAKIEFF），他在加入温甘男爵（Baron UNGERN）支队期间因暴行而臭名昭著；V.V.布哈罗夫（V.V. BOUKHAROFF）和V.A.米巴洛夫（V.A. MYBALOFF），前《上海黎明报》（Shanghai Zaria）和《言论报》（Slovo）的撰稿人。像所有苏维埃组织一样，该联盟拥有一个“妇女部”，负责组织这些舞会。值得注意的是，联盟章程的第一条规定，其成员必须严格服从执行机构，不得讨论领导人的任何命令。这一条款充分揭示了该组织的“契卡”性质。联盟委员会的一名成员难道没有说过吗，“国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）拥有两百多名不领薪水的秘密特工”。这些特工在上海的许多俄国和外国组织中活动。联盟的大多数成员已接到命令，不得泄露他们与该组织的隶属关系。他们被要求参与移民组织的活动

d'émigrés et d'en informer l'Union. Ils donnent des renseignements
sur les membres des organisations blanches, sur leurs dirigeants,
etc... Quand il le faut, ces agents s'efforcent de diriger les
activités des organisations blanches dans une fausse voie, insis-
tant sur la mise en vigueur du mot d'ordre : "Nous ne faisons pas
de politique", sèment l'animosité, jettent l'opprobre sur les
vrais patriotes russes et font l'impossible pour désagréger l'émi-
gration. De puissantes cellules de "personnes désireuses de ren-
trer en URSS" existent au sein du régiment russe du S.V.C., dans
le détachement auxiliaire de la Police française et à la police
spéciale. Le commandement du régiment préférant les soldats de
grande taille, sportifs etc, et plusieurs anciens soldats ayant
été licenciés, l'infiltration des "Vozvrastchentsi" dans le régi-
ment en a été beaucoup facilitée. La tolérance du commandement à
l'égard des opinions politiques de ses hommes favorise également
cet état de choses. Tous les ordres émanant de la direction de la
Police Municipale et de l'Etat-Major du S.M.C. relatifs à la dé-
fense du Settlement sont rapportés immédiatement par des espions
bénévoles, au Consulat des Soviets. De nombreux membres de l'Union
des "Vozvrastchentsi" ont tâché d'obtenir au cours du conflit, un
travail quelconque au delà de la crique de Soochow, en s'engageant
comme porteurs, etc... pour surveiller les activités des troupes
nippones et en informer le consulat des soviets. Les membres de
l'Union au service des grandes usines et entreprises étrangères,
y font de l'espionnage économique et servent, parfois d'agents
de liaison entre les dirigeants du Komintern et les ouvriers chi-
nois bolchevisants. Ils sont d'habitude en dehors de tout
soupçon parce qu'ils sont Russes "blancs". Les membres de la sec-
tion des femmes de l'Union ont aussi leur champ d'activités.
Nombre d'entre elles travaillent comme serveuses dans les bars et
pages.zh:
附件第2号 - 第4页。

并向联盟报告。他们提供关于白俄组织成员及其领导人等的信息。必要时，这些特工努力将白俄组织的活动引入歧途，坚持推行“我们不搞政治”的口号，散布敌意，抹黑真正的俄罗斯爱国者，并竭尽全力瓦解移民群体。在万国商团（S.V.C.）俄军团、法国巡捕房辅助队以及特别警察队内部，存在着强大的“希望返回苏联者”细胞。由于俄军团指挥部偏好身材高大、擅长运动等的士兵，且多名老兵已被遣散，“回归者”（Vozvrastchentsi）渗入该团变得容易得多。指挥部对其下属政治观点的容忍也助长了这种状况。来自工部局警务处和万国商团参谋部关于保卫租界的所有命令，均由志愿间谍立即报告给苏联领事馆。许多“回归者”联盟成员试图在冲突期间越过苏州河去谋得某种工作，如受雇为搬运工等，以监视日军活动并向苏联领事馆报告。在大型外资工厂和企业服务的联盟成员，在那里进行经济间谍活动，有时还充当共产国际领导人与赤化中国工人之间的联络人。他们通常不受怀疑，因为他们是“白”俄人。联盟妇女部的成员也有她们的活动领域。其中许多人在酒吧当女招待，

pages.en:
Annexe N°2 - p.5

font connaissance avec les soldats et marins étrangers. C'est
par l'intermédiaire de la section des femmes qu'est mené le tra-
vail de propagande communiste et d'espionnage. C'est par cette
voie que certains secrets militaires de la marine américaine sont
déjà parvenus à Moscou. C'est ainsi que se trouve sur le Settle-
ment, au centre de la ville, un centre d'espionnage protégé par
un détachement spécial de la police municipale. Il est sous la
protection de puissances étrangères dont aucune n'est alliée de
l'URSS, comme la France, mais sont pour la plupart ennemis du
Komintern, tels le Japon, l'Italie, l'Allemagne, les Pays-Bas, la
Belgique, etc... Cette anomalie est d'autant plus curieuse que
les autorités de la concession française, liées étroitement avec
les représentants soviétiques (connaissant bien la nature du
travail de l'Union des émigrés russes désireux de rentrer en
URSS et craignant d'être entraînées dans un incident avec le
Japon, contre lequel est actuellement dirigé tout le travail du
Komintern), ont refusé la demande de l'Union de se transférer en
Concession Française.

Par conséquent chacun doit comprendre que la politique, des
autorités municipales tend à aider directement et ouvertement le
Komintern. Le Corps Consulaire doit porter son attention sur ce
fait avant qu'il ne provoque de graves incidents. Il faut mettre
fin au travail du Komintern dans le Settlement.

并与外国士兵和水手结识。共产主义宣传和间谍工作正是通过妇女部进行的。通过这条渠道，美国海军的一些军事机密已经传到了莫斯科。就这样，在租界市中心，存在一个受工部局警察特别分队保护的间谍中心。它受到外国势力的保护，这些国家中没有一个是苏联的盟友，如法国，但大多是共产国际的敌人，如日本、意大利、德国、荷兰、比利时等。这种反常现象尤为奇怪，因为法租界当局与苏联代表关系密切（深知希望返回苏联的俄侨联盟工作的性质，并害怕卷入与日本的争端，目前共产国际的全部工作都针对日本），拒绝了该联盟迁入法租界的请求。

因此，每个人都必须明白，工部局当局的政策倾向于直接和公开地帮助共产国际。领事团必须在这一事实引发严重事件之前予以关注。必须终止共产国际在租界内的活动。

Ne donnez pas votre argent aux bolcheviques.

Nombreux sont les émigrés "blancs" qui, volontairement ou non, soutiennent pécuniairement l'existence et les activités du soviet interné à l'étranger. Lorsqu'ils achètent des produits soviétiques, les émigrés russes favorisent le commerce de l'URSS et contribuent ainsi à développer le travail forcé en URSS et à renforcer l'influence économique et politique des soviets. L'argent des émigrés permet en outre aux bolcheviques, d'entretenir des agents provocateurs dans leurs milieux. L'émigration russe doit boycotter les marchandises soviétiques. L'argent des émigrés, si péniblement gagné, doit être versé aux magasins "blancs" dont les propriétaires soutiennent la cause russe. Aucune excuse n'est acceptable quand il s'agit de la lutte contre la contagion rouge. Boycottez les magasins des "émigrés désireux de rentrer en URSS" et ceux des citoyens soviétiques. Supprimez toute relation avec ceux qui les soutiennent. Invitez vos amis à suivre cet exemple. Dites à tous : "qui n'est pas avec nous est contre nous".

不要把你的钱给布尔什维克。

许多“白”俄移民，无论自愿与否，都在经济上支持流亡海外的苏维埃政权的生存和活动。当俄侨购买苏联产品时，他们促进了苏联的贸易，从而有助于发展苏联的强迫劳动，并加强苏维埃的经济和政治影响力。此外，移民的钱使布尔什维克得以在其圈子内维持挑衅代理人。俄侨必须抵制苏联货物。移民们辛苦挣来的钱应当花在“白”人商店里，这些店主支持俄罗斯事业。在对抗红色传染的斗争中，没有任何借口是可以接受的。抵制“希望返回苏联的移民”和苏联公民的商店。切断与支持他们的人的一切联系。邀请您的朋友效仿此举。告诉所有人：“谁不和我们在一起，就是反对我们”。

On cherche un emplacement.

Les émigrés russes sérieusement atteints par la crise du logement, à la suite de la vague des réfugiés, durent, sous menace d'être expulsés à Wenchow (à l'instar de D.I. TOFF) se conformer aux ordres des autorités françaises relatifs à l'enregistrement de tous les émigrés russes résidant sur la Concession. Un impôt spécial de deux dollars est perçu auprès de toute personne qui se fait enregistrer, ainsi les émigrés russes qui paient déjà les impôts imposés à tous les résidents de la concession française sont soumis à une nouvelle charge injustifiée. Tous les Russes se rendent bien compte que cette "pression" est le résultat de la servilité des autorités françaises locales à l'égard des dirigeants soviétiques et communistes. Nous osons affirmer que l'affaire ne s'arrêtera pas là. "L'appétit vient en mangeant" dit un adage français; la colonie russe doit s'attendre à de nouvelles mesures d'oppression. Le meilleur moyen d'y échapper en particulier pour les Russes "blancs" qui s'occupent activement de politique, est d'aller habiter dans un autre quartier de la ville. Lettre à la rédaction.

"Tchoubarovtzy" (1).

Le 6, à 7 h. du soir, alors que je passais devant la "Boulangerie russe", avenue du Roi Albert, je fus accosté par un jeune homme, ivre de boisson, me cherchant noise sans raison. Il plongea sa main dans la poche de son veston d'où il retira un crayon disant en anglais : Voilà justement ce que je cherchais. Je le priai de me rendre mon crayon, mais il leva la main comme pour me frapper. Je m'éloignais pour éviter un incident; mais il me suivit. Je fus obligé de courir en direction de l'avenue Joffre. Il courut après moi poussant des cris comme un insensé. Dans l'avenue Joffre, je rencontrai l'agent auxiliaire russe No 182, accompagné d'un agent chinois. Je lui déclarai qu'un individu causait du scandale dans l'Avenue du Roi Albert et tracassait les passants. Il ne me répondit pas et continua tranquillement son chemin comme s'il n'avait rien à voir dans cette affaire.
signé : "Un passant".

(1) "Tchoubarovtzy" est le nom sous lequel sont désignés en URSS des vauriens et des rascals. Il provient du nom d'une rue de Moscou, devenue célèbre par les exploits de ces individus.

致编辑部的信。

“Tchoubarovtzy”(1)。

6日晚上7点，当我经过阿尔伯特王路（今淮海中路）的“俄罗斯面包店”时，一个喝醉的年轻人无缘无故地找我麻烦。他把手伸进上衣口袋，拿出一支铅笔，用英语说：这正是我在找的。我请他把铅笔还给我，但他举起手好像要打我。我走开以避免发生冲突；但他跟着我。我被迫朝霞飞路方向跑去。他在我后面追赶，像疯子一样大喊大叫。在霞飞路上，我遇到了俄国辅助探员第182号， accompanied by a Chinese constable（伴随一名华捕）。我告诉他，有人在阿尔伯特王路闹事并骚扰路人。他没有回答我，而是平静地继续走他的路，仿佛与此事无关。
签名：“一名路人”。

(1) “Tchoubarovtzy”是苏联用来称呼流氓和无赖的名称。它源自莫斯科一条街道的名字，因这些人的恶行而闻名。

Notre article publié dans le No1 du "Shanghai Hooper" a sou-
levé un grand intérêt parmi nos lecteurs et attiré de nombreux

En effet les locataires ne doivent pas être très rassurés

La figure terrifiante de la "house-missi", tant de fois carica-

toujours se produire un événement heureux qui modifiera la si-

中国租户利益的法律保护。

我们在《Shanghai Hooper》第1期上发表的文章引起了读者的极大兴趣，并引来了许多评论。

确实，租户目前并不感到十分安心。他们经常不得不寻求司法援助，以一方面对抗转租人，另一方面对抗房东，从而维护自身利益。“女管家”（house-missi）那可怕的形象——常被漫画描绘为一只爪子里抓着一叠账单的鳄鱼——已经过去了。角色发生了逆转。在大多数情况下，是租户受到其转租人的困扰。

很多时候，需要安置全家的转租人支付的定金不超过5美元，占住房间后，便请求房东“宽限几天”支付剩余租金。在这“几天”里，总会发生某种幸运的事情来改变局

pages.en:
tuation. Tantôt il s'agit de l'envoi d'un ch... d'un
mandat poste, tantôt l'intéressé attend obtenir un emploi,
etc... et le locataire promet qu'à la suite il est heureux
évidemment, il versera le loyer en entier et peut-être même
pour plusieurs mois en avance.

Les locataires trouvent sans cesse des raisons abracadabrantes pour retarder le paiement de leur loyer. Tantôt c'est
la chambre qui est mal aérée, tantôt le bain n'est pas assez
chaud, ou encore les serviteurs chinois sont grossiers et sales.
Il faut admettre que ce type de sous-locataire de chambres est
très répandu. Ils paient "en principe" et réclament continuellement.

Pour les expulser, il faut s'adresser à la Cour, car
les moyens d'expulsion personnels conduisent trop souvent au si
non pas devant la Cour, mais devant le tribunal criminel : les
disputes se terminent par des querelles au cours desquelles
des coups sont facilement échangés.

Les demandes d'éviction et de remboursement portées devant
la Cour reviennent trop chères et les plaignants ne peuvent s'
assurer la défense d'un avocat. C'est pourquoi nombreuses sont
les affaires de ce genre où le plaignant recourt au service
d'un interprète malhabile (dans la majorité des cas l'un des
fournisseurs chinois) qui rédige malhabilement la plainte; ainsi
le procès se complique et s'embrouille.

La situation des locataires devient encore plus difficile
s'ils ont à faire à des propriétaires jouissant des droits
d'extraterritorialité.

On se rappelle comment le représentant d'une grande compagnie immobilière procéda à une expulsion. Au lieu de s'adresser à la Cour, la Compagnie préfère expulser les locataires
par ses propres moyens, avec l'aide de ses employés. En ce
qui concerne les locaux commerciaux - on les ferme avec des
pages.zh:
面。有时是收到一张支票或邮政汇票，有时是当事人等待获得工作机会，等等……而租户承诺，随后——显然他很乐意——将全额支付租金，甚至可能预付几个月的租金。

租户不断寻找荒诞离奇的理由来拖延支付租金。有时是房间通风不良，有时是洗澡水不够热，或者是中国佣人粗鲁肮脏。必须承认，这种类型的房间转租人非常普遍。他们“原则上”付款，并不断提出要求。

要驱逐他们，必须诉诸法院，因为个人驱逐手段往往导致的后果不是上民事法庭，而是上刑事法庭：争吵很容易演变成斗殴。

向法院提出的驱逐和退款诉讼费用过高，原告无法聘请律师进行辩护。因此，在此类案件中，许多原告求助于不熟练的口译员（在大多数情况下是某位中国供应商），由他们笨拙地起草诉状；这使得诉讼过程变得复杂且混乱。

如果租户面对的是享有治外法权的房东，他们的处境会变得更加困难。

人们还记得一家大型房地产公司的代表是如何进行驱逐的。该公司不愿诉诸法院，而是倾向于在其雇员的帮助下，通过自己的手段驱逐租户。至于商业场所——他们用锁将其封闭，并将库存物品拍卖。

pages.en:

Les mécontents ont le droit de porter plainte devant
la cour compétente.

Nous pensons que tous les cas déplorables qui nous sont
signalés par la presse, n'existeraient pas si l'on créait une
association des locataires.

L'organisation de la défense légale des intérêts des mem-
bres de l'association doit avoir dès le début des résultats
favorables, car l'existence même de cette organisation mettra
un frein aux activités arbitraires des propriétaires.

Quelques procès intentés par les membres de l'association
éveilleraient le sens des responsabilités.

signé : A... ...DIT.
pages.zh:
不满者有权向主管法院提起诉讼。

我们认为，如果成立一个租户协会，媒体向我们报道的所有那些令人遗憾的情况就不会存在。

从一开始，组织起来保护协会成员利益的法律行动就必须取得有利结果，因为该组织本身的存在将对房东的专断行为起到遏制作用。

由协会成员提起的几起诉讼将唤醒责任感。

Conservez vos anciens passeports.

Les visas pour les Etats-Unis et pour l'Europe ne sont apposés que sur les passeports délivrés par le Gouvernement de Nankin.

Un représentant de la Police Française nous a déclaré hier que l'enregistrement des émigrés russes se poursuit normalement. Le nombre exact des personnes enregistrées n'a pas encore été relevé car il ne pourra être définitivement établi qu'à la fin de l'enregistrement dont le délai expire le 7 mai.

On ne signale aucun cas de refus de délivrance de la "carte d'identité". Même les personnes qui ont été poursuivies en justice ou qui ont subi des peines de prison sont enregistrées.

Les émigrés croient que ces "cartes d'identité" ou certificats de résidence tiennent lieu de passeports. Il n'en est pas ainsi en réalité.

Il ressort de notre enquête à ce sujet que ces certificats donnent seulement le droit de résider dans la Concession Française.

Многіе представители бѣлой эмиграціи сознательно и несознательно, своими средствами поддерживают существованіе и дѣятельность зарубежнаго отдѣла коминтерна. Покупая совѣтскіе товары, подерживая совѣтскую торговлю и коммерсантов, бѣлые эмигранты углубляют принудительный труд пленных въ СССР, укрѣпляют совѣтское торговое, а съ ним и политическое, вліяніе. Таким же образом эмигрантскія деньги помогают большевикам, содержать агентов —разлагателей въ средѣ иммигрантов. Русская эмиграція как один человѣкъ должна отказаться от совѣтских магазинов и товаров. Русскіе трудовые деньги должны итти в бѣлые магазины, владѣльцы которых помогают русскому дѣлу. Никаких отговорокъ не может быть когда дѣло касается борьбы о красной заразой. Бойкотируйте возвращенцев и совѣтчиков, бойкотируйте всѣх кто помогает им. Зовите ваших знакомых и друзей к активному бойкоту, говорите всѣм: кто не съ нами, тот против нас.

Obscure Russian - Language
Anti-Soviet Weekly Appears

Of obscure origin, a new Russian- language weekly newspaper has so far made four appearances in Shanghai since March 26. The paper, which gives the name of its editor and publisher as a Mrs. V. P. Trindina, has mystified Russian circles here all the more because the name is completely unknown in Russian journalistic circles. The aim of the paper, evidently, is to spread anti-Soviet propaganda. Calling itself the "Active," the publication announced that it is printed in neither of the two foreign-administered areas, but omits the address of its offices.

Although the paper is priced at 10 cents a copy, it is at present distributed freely through the local post office. It is not believed that its circulation has attained the three-figure mark as yet, as only a limited number of people have been known to have received it.

The publication does not carry any advertisements, the only mention to trade being a campaign for the emigre population to boycott Soviet-manufactured cargo.

The first copy of the paper carried on its front page a photo of Noulens-Ruegg, famous communist propagandist, whose arrest and trial in China several years ago was widely-publicized, and who was recently released. The photograph bore the stamp of the former Chinese police, and presumably has been obtained from police files either in Nantao or Nanking.

The latest copy of the paper, which made its appearance on April 16, carried a bannerline across the front page urging people to "Boycott Soviet Goods."

来源不明的俄语
反苏周刊出现

一份来源不明的俄语新周刊自3月26日以来已在上海出版了四期。该报将其编辑和出版人署名为V. P. 特林迪娜（V. P. Trindina）女士，由于这个名字在俄国新闻界完全无人知晓，因此更令当地的俄国圈子感到困惑。显然，该报的目的是传播反苏宣传。该刊物自称为《活跃》（Active），宣称其印刷地点不在两个外国管辖区域内的任何一处，但省略了其办公室地址。

虽然该报定价为每份10分，但目前正通过当地邮局免费分发。据信其发行量尚未达到三位数，因为只有有限数量的人已知收到该报。

该出版物不刊登任何广告，提及商业的唯一内容是发起一场运动，呼吁流亡人口抵制苏联制造的货物。

该报的第一期头版刊登了努伦斯-鲁格（Noulens-Ruegg）的照片，他是一位著名的共产主义宣传家，几年前在中国的逮捕和审判曾广为报道，最近获释。照片上盖有前中国警察的印章，推测是从南市或南京的警察档案中获得的。

最新一期于4月16日出版，头版横跨一条大字标题，敦促人们“抵制苏联货”。

Translation from Russian newspaper "ACTIV"
of 23.4.38.

1. Article entitled "What Shall we Eat?"

Commenting on an article appearing in the "Shanghai Rupor"
of 19.4.38, in which are described unemployment and poverty
prevailing in the local Russian community, the "Activ" writes:-

It is not sufficient to put before the public openly and
honestly the question of difficult economic position of Russian
emigrants. It is also necessary to give an open and honest
reply to this question. The solution of the problem lies in
providing work for all unemployed Russian emigrants. Representatives
of the Russian community who have entrenched themselves in the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, do not wish even to hear about
unemployment among Russians. Russian "national" newspapers
also had not the courage to write on this subject. Representatives
of the French Consulate and Municipal Council of the International
Settlement allotted small sums for relief work among refugees
from areas affected by the hostilities, but did not go to the
root of the question. We cannot reproach the Russian National
Committee of inactivity, because this body has only very limited
funds. We cannot blame the broad masses of emigrants for the
poor support accorded by them to the Russian National Committee,
because the majority of them are in need themselves. We expect
that those few emigrants who live in comparatively comfortable
circumstances will at last understand the difficult position
of many thousands of Russians and will actively participate in
and contribute to the relief work among the unemployed.

We hope that the authorities of the French Concession
and International Settlement, instead of persecuting the "Activ",
will consider the Russian problem and adopt a series of measures
in order to improve the present difficult economic position of
Russian emigrants. No matter how sympathetic the attitude of
various charitable organizations
is towards Russian population, charity is not a solution of the
problem. What is wanted is-organization of public works. This
is quite within the power of the two municipalities, should
pages.zh:
译自1938年4月23日的俄语报纸《活跃》。

1. 题为《我们吃什么？》的文章。

《活跃》报在评论1938年4月19日《上海回声》（Shanghai Rupor）上刊登的一篇描述当地俄国社区普遍存在的失业和贫困状况的文章时写道：-

仅仅公开诚实地向公众提出俄国流亡者经济地位困难的问题是不够的。还需要对这个问题给出公开诚实的回答。解决问题的办法在于为所有失业的俄国流亡者提供工作。盘踞在俄国流亡者委员会中的俄国社区代表，甚至不愿听到俄国人失业的消息。俄国的‘民族’报纸也没有勇气撰写有关此主题的文章。法国领事馆和国际租界工部局的代表拨出小额款项用于受战乱影响地区难民的救济工作，但并未触及问题的根本。我们不能指责俄国民族委员会不作为，因为该机构资金非常有限。我们不能责怪广大流亡者对俄国民族委员会的支持不力，因为他们大多数人自身也处于困境之中。我们期望那些少数生活相对舒适的流亡者最终能理解成千上万俄国人的艰难处境，并积极参与和捐助失业救济工作。

我们希望法租界和国际租界的当局不要迫害《活跃》报，而是考虑俄国问题，并采取一系列措施以改善俄国流亡者目前困难的经济状况。无论各种慈善组织对俄国人口的态度多么同情，慈善并非解决问题的办法。所需要的是——组织公共工程。如果两个市政当局愿意，这完全在他们的能力范围之内，

pages.en:
(2)
they wish to do so. Moreover, if public works are properly
organized, employment can be provided for tens of thousands of
Chinese refugees who now overfill all the empty houses, as well
as all refugees' camps. Thus, enormous man-power is being wasted.
Starvation drives people to commit crimes. The authorities are
alarmed by the possibility of epidemics during the summer due
to the abnormal congestion of population in the area, but do not
propose to go further than preventive innoculations.
The Franco-Soviet pact and the growth of pro-Soviet tendencies
among British political leaders do not constitute a good reason
for inhuman treatment of Russian emigrants. The Political
Section of the French Police objects to our telling the true
facts of the situation in the Russian community. But was it
possible to remain silent regarding the treacherous kidnapping
of D.I. Goostoff, about the "registration tax" imposed by the
French authorities on the needy Russian community, about individuals
who pursue aims of personal gain under the cover of public
activities?
The French authorities should treat the Russian question,
generally, and the question of our newspaper, in particular, not
from the formal viewpoint only, but should go to the root of the
problem. Justice demands that the French authorities, who rely
on the Russian Detachment, Russian Volunteers, Russian policemen
and the loyalty of the entire Russian population, realize the
catastrophic extent of starvation among Russians and take
effective steps in order to relieve the situation.
In the International Settlement, where the Russian Regiment,
Russian Volunteers, Russian Specials and many Russians in other
municipal departments participate to a considerable extent in
the maintaining law and order in the city, an end must be put
to the negligent attitude towards the Russian question. Activities
of detectives of the type of Emelianoff and Prokofiev arouse
hatred and also may lead to riots of starving people and to
terrorist acts. Russians want bread and work, but not police
repressions.
pages.zh:
(2)
如果他们愿意这样做的话。此外，如果公共工程组织得当，可以为目前挤满所有空屋以及所有难民营的数万名中国难民提供就业机会。因此，大量的人力正被浪费。饥饿驱使人们犯罪。当局对该地区人口异常拥挤可能导致夏季爆发流行病感到担忧，但除了采取预防性接种外，并不打算采取进一步措施。
《法苏互助条约》以及英国政治领导人中亲苏倾向的增长，并不能构成对俄国移民进行不人道待遇的正当理由。法国警察的政治处反对我们披露俄国社区局势的真实情况。但是，对于D.I. Goostoff（音译）遭到背信弃义的绑架、法国当局向贫困的俄国社区征收“登记税”、以及某些人打着公共活动的幌子谋取私利等行为，难道能保持沉默吗？
法国当局在处理俄国问题总体上，以及在处理本报问题上，不应仅从形式角度出发，而应探究问题的根源。正义要求依赖俄国分队、俄国志愿人员、俄国警察以及整个俄国人口忠诚度的法国当局，认识到俄国人遭受饥饿的灾难性程度，并采取有效措施以缓解这一局势。
在公共租界，俄国团、俄国志愿人员、俄国特别警员以及市政其他部门中的许多俄国人，在维持城市治安方面发挥着相当大的作用，必须结束对俄国问题的疏忽态度。像Emelianoff（音译）和Prokofiev（音译）这类侦探的活动激起了仇恨，也可能导致饥民暴动和恐怖主义行为。俄国人想要的是面包和工作，而不是警察的镇压。

pages.en:
(3)

Following Hitler's advent to power in Austria, 15 countries
responded to the outcries against the persecutions of Jews in
that country and agreed to admit refugees from Austria. After
the appalling distress, prevailing in the Russian community as
a result of the recent hostilities, has become apparent, the
Municipal authorities, if they are unable to solve the Russian
problem by their own means, should render to local Russians
assistance in the matter of migration to other countries.
Changes of the political situation are no excuse for forgetting
elementary principles of humanism."

2. Article entitled "The Work of Renegades"
(Shooting sparrows with cannons)

"In those memorable days when foreign owned goods were
removed from godowns in the Hongkew and Yangtszepoo districts,
when various shady business men, abusing the confidence of the
Japanese authorities, removed property worth hundreds of
thousands and not belonging to them, members of the Municipal
Police were blissfully ignorant of this. Now, when Russian
destitutes pick up bits of various articles thrown away and
decaying in destroyed houses, municipal detectives display their
"gallantry" in the struggle against these "criminals." The Police
authorities who permitted colossal thefts and open looting to
take place, now endeavour to atone for this by bringing before
the court people guilty of having picked up an alarm clock or
pair of gloves thrown away by their owners. By discharging
their duty in this doubtful manner the detectives hardly will
win the gratitude of the public. Residents of this city
expect real protection of their property, and not only a show
of work.

3. Article entitled "We Refuse To Be Intimidated."

"Agents of the Police, Soviet agents-provocateurs, Soviet
citizens and other personages from the underworld are making
attempts to intimidate Russian emigrants and isolate them from
the White Movement. These miserable attempts to hinder the
pages.zh:
(3)

继希特勒在奥地利掌权之后，15个国家响应了反对该国迫害犹太人的呼声，并同意接纳来自奥地利的难民。在最近的敌对行动导致俄国社区普遍陷入可怕困境的事实变得明显之后，市政当局如果无法凭自身力量解决俄国问题，应在当地俄国人迁移至其他国家的问题上向他们提供援助。政治局势的变化不能成为忘记基本人道主义原则的借口。”

2. 题为《叛徒的行径》的文章
（用大炮打麻雀）

“在那些值得纪念的日子里，当外商拥有的货物从虹口和杨树浦地区的仓库中被搬走时，当各种不法商人滥用日本当局的信任，搬走价值数十万且不属于他们的财产时，工部局警务处的成员却对此一无所知，安享无知之乐。如今，当俄国贫民拾取被丢弃并在被毁房屋中腐烂的各种零星物品时，工部局侦探却在打击这些‘罪犯’的斗争中展示他们的‘英勇’。允许大规模盗窃和公开掠夺发生的警察当局，现在试图通过将那些捡拾主人丢弃的闹钟或手套的人送上法庭来赎罪。侦探们以这种可疑的方式履行职责，很难赢得公众的感激。本市居民期待的是对其财产的真正保护，而不仅仅是做样子的工作。

3. 题为《我们拒绝被恐吓》的文章。

“警察代理人、苏联挑衅代理人、苏联公民以及其他黑社会人物正试图恐吓俄国移民，并将他们与白俄运动隔离开来。这些阻碍

pages.en:
(4)
growth of national consciousness and the activities of
"White" elements are bound to fail. Imaginary fears will
gradually lose their power, because the intimidators have
no ground to stand on. We cannot be condemned because we,
white emigrants, wish to profess our political opinions and
endeavour to improve the general position of emigrants.
Russian emigrants should not forget that they have not only
enemies, but many friends as well. The treacherous kidnapping
of U.I. Goostoff, which accounts for the loss of simpathy
of Russian emigrants towards the French Authorities, shows
that thousands of Russian residents of the French Concession
are weak only through lack of organization. The growth of
the White Movement will force the authorities to adopt a more
considerate and correct attitude towards white Russians.
Provocative methods of intimidation ~~methods~~ are the last shadows
of the past.
The authorities of the French Concession and International
Settlement will be compelled to recognize the White Movement.
The struggle for the legal status of Russian emigrants will
result in a complete Russian ~~victory~~ victory. The French
Consulate as well as the Municipal Council will have to take
into consideration the opinion of Russian emigrants. It
should not be forgotten that Russian community is many
thousands strong and constitutes a power that cannot be
ignored.
-------------
pages.zh:
(4)
民族意识增长和‘白俄’分子活动的可怜企图注定要失败。想象中的恐惧将逐渐失去其力量，因为恐吓者没有立足之地。我们不能因为我们作为白俄移民希望表达我们的政治观点并努力改善移民的整体处境而受到谴责。俄国移民不应忘记，他们不仅有敌人，也有许多朋友。U.I. Goostoff（音译）遭到背信弃义的绑架，这一事件解释了为何俄国移民对法国当局失去同情，这表明法租界的数千名俄国居民之所以软弱，仅仅是因为缺乏组织。白俄运动的发展将迫使当局对白俄采取更加体谅和正确的态度。挑衅性的恐吓~~方法~~是过去的最后阴影。
法租界和公共租界的当局将被迫承认白俄运动。争取俄国移民合法地位的斗争将取得完全的俄国~~胜利~~胜利。法国领事馆以及工部局都将不得不考虑俄国移民的意见。不应忘记，俄国社区人数多达数千，构成了一股不可忽视的力量。

2. Eviction from the emigrants' organizations of all per-

suing personal interests.

3. Eviction from the emigrants' organizations of all in-
active elements.

4. Boycott of Soviet goods, shops and enterprises. Wide
propaganda of the boycott.

5. Support of business conducted by emigrants.

6. Organization of national mutual aid.

7. Doing away with unemployment among Russian emigrants.

8. Opening of a public dining room where wholesome food
could be obtained by emigrants at reasonable prices.

9. Organization of cheap lodging houses, etc.

10. Establishment of an Educational Committee which will
take charge of all Russian schools and supervise the education of
Russian youth.

11. Exposing agents of the Comintern and obstructing their
activities by every possible means.

12. Support and defence of active elements among white Rus-
sians. Distribution of our newspaper.

ties in South Manchuria Railway Zone for the improvement of the

of the article reads as follows:-

that a plan has been suggested in Shanghai for the organization

《行动报》第四期于4月16日出版，
一篇题为《我们的纲领》的文章中，“白俄运动指导中心”建议所有白俄移民参与执行以下任务：-

1. 将所有政治敌人，如苏联公民、归国联盟成员、苏联代理人及挑衅代理人，从移民组织中清除出去。

2. 将所有利用这些组织作为掩护以从事追求个人利益活动的人员，从移民组织中清除出去。

3. 将所有不活跃分子从移民组织中清除出去。

4. 抵制苏联商品、商店和企业。广泛宣传抵制运动。

5. 支持移民经营的业务。

6. 组织民族互助。

7. 消除俄国移民中的失业现象。

8. 开设公共食堂，使移民能以合理价格获得健康食品。

9. 组织廉价旅馆等。

10. 成立教育委员会，负责管理所有俄国学校并监督俄国青年的教育。

11. 揭露共产国际代理人，并以一切可能手段阻碍其活动。

the third issue of the "Activ", an unregistered Russian newspaper, appeared on April 9. The irresponsible character of this anonymous publication has become still more pronounced, as will be seen from the following translation:-

EDITORIAL NOTE.

A few days ago Detective Sub-Inspectors Machnovsky and Konovaloff attached to headquarters of the Municipal Police arrested one J.A. Ushanoff in whose lodging were found two revolvers, bombs and explosives contained in an attache case. According to the arrested man, the attache case had been left to him for safe keeping by an unknown Russian who arrived from Harbin. Knowing the "remarkable" work of municipal detectives we may presume that this is but another demonstration of the gallant services of these "white" emigrants. Seeking to win the favour of their chiefs, these gentlemen are not averse of creating "crimes" by means of a provocation in order gallantly to catch the "criminals" afterwards. The "unknown Russian" may easily prove to be an informer in the pay of the detectives. It would be a very simple matter to leave the attache case for safe keeping to unsuspecting Ushanoff. As a result, J.A. Ushanoff is in gaol, and the detectives have performed a "brilliant" detection of the crime and-who knows- may be they will get a monetary reward. It would not be altogether out of place for the Municipal Authorities to check the criminal investigation work of the Municipal Police from time to time. Otherwise, the detectives carried away by their successes, will begin to "frame up" absolutely innocent people.

Stop distribution in Settlement if found Unregistered.

（印：MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 13 APR. 1938）

The leading article contains a passage eulogizing Anatole Drohin, a Russian youth who stabbed a Soviet consular official in Dairen in 1928 or 1929.

S.I.

编者按。

几天前，隶属于工部局警务处总部的侦探副督察 Machnovsky 和 Konovaloff 逮捕了一名 J.A. Ushanoff，在其住所内发现了一个公文箱，里面装有两支左轮手枪、炸弹和爆炸物。据被捕者称，该公文箱是由一名从哈尔滨来的不知名俄国人交给他保管的。鉴于工部局侦探们“出色”的工作，我们可以推测，这不过是这些“白俄”移民英勇服务的又一次展示。为了博取上司的欢心，这些先生们不介意通过挑衅手段制造“犯罪”，以便随后英勇地抓获“罪犯”。那位“不知名的俄国人”很容易证明是侦探们雇佣的线人。将公文箱交给毫无戒心的 Ushanoff 保管是一件非常简单的事情。结果是，J.A. Ushanoff 身陷囹圄，而侦探们则完成了一次“精彩”的破案，并且——谁知道呢——也许他们还会获得金钱奖励。工部局当局不时检查工部局警务处的刑事调查工作并非不合时宜。否则，侦探们被成功冲昏头脑，就会开始“构陷”完全无辜的人。

若在租界内发现此未注册刊物，请停止分发。

remuneration undertook to represent the interests of D.I. Joostoff,"

“值得注意的是，该联盟的规则之一要求严格服从联盟领导人的所有命令。这暴露了该组织的“契卡”性质，并解释了其一位领导人的一句愤世嫉俗的话，大意是在联盟中，格别乌拥有超过200名无薪特工。大多数成员被禁止披露其参与联盟活动的事实。他们受命渗透进移民组织并报告其活动。”

“在俄国团、上海义勇队（S.V.C.）以及法国警察的俄国志愿分队中，存在强大的联盟成员细胞。在招募新人时，该团的军官非常关注申请人的身体素质，但对他们的政治可靠性漠不关心。所有关

Attached herewith is a copy of the "Aktiv" (Action),
a weekly Russian newspaper devoted to the White Movement;
which made its first appearance on March 26, 1938.
On the front page of the newspaper it is stated that
it is published and edited by one Mrs. V.P. Tryndin. It is
not known where its editorial and printing offices are located,
but on page 3 the following temporary address is given for
communication with the editor: "SPEED STUDIO, P.O. Box 4039,
Shanghai, China."
Enquiries at 720-"C" Avenue Foch, the last known address
of the "Speed Studio," show that a few days ago all printing
presses belonging to this establishment were removed from the
premises, but that Mr. C.V. Batoorin, proprietor (or principal
partner) of the "Speed Studio", still resides in or visits a
room in Flat "C". A note was left with a Chinese watchman
employed at the place, requesting Batoorin to communicate
with the undersigned.
At 10 a.m. on 27/3/38 a telephone call was received from
Mr. S. Muzalevsky, Batoorin's friend. Asked about the news-
paper, its editor, address and its connection with the "Speed
Studio," he said that he had no connection whatever with the
newspaper and did not know who its editor was, and where it
was printed. He also stated that the printing presses of the
"Speed Studio" had been sold by Batoorin to an unknown party
and had been removed from the premises a few days ago, probably,

procedure.

the area North of the Creek. The general trend of articles

Translation of extracts from Russian newspaper entitled
"KITV", March 26, 1938.

1. Leading article.

After a brief review of the internal and external
situation in the U.S.S.R., the author comes to the conclusion
that

" Time has come for Russian emigrants to wake up
and for old combatants to get ready. A new White Day is near-
ing and calls us for action"....

" The rapid development of the Sino-Japanese con-
flict has considerably reduced the sphere of influence of the
Soviet Consulate in Shanghai. The Japanese Imperial Army who
is sweeping communism out of China with an iron broom, has
doomed local Soviet representatives to a miserable existence.
The field is open for white activities in Shanghai. It's our
time and our play now, and we must utilize this favourable si-
tuation to our best advantage.....

"The growth of the national consciousness of the
Russian community demands an expression by white elements,
demands action. The appearance of the first issue of our
journal is the beginning of this action"......

2. From article entitled " At the point where interests clash

International Shanghai is a place where conflicting
interests of many powers clash. Russian emigrants residing in
this city, in order not to be trampled down in this struggle,
have, whether they like it or not, to rely on a power who can
protect them and will not betray them at a critical moment.

It would be natural for the authorities of the
French Concession where many Russians reside to accord them
such protection. Franco-Russian friendship is a tradition
of a long standing, and Russian emigrants certainly have many
friends among the French people. But friendship is one thing
and the policy of the French cabinet - another, not to speak
of the attitude of the pink and red elements in France.
pages.zh:
题为《KITV》的俄文报纸摘录译文，
1938年3月26日。

1. 社论。

在简要回顾了苏联的内外局势后，作者得出结论认为

“俄罗斯流亡者觉醒的时刻已经到来，
老战士们已做好准备。新的‘白色日子’临近，
召唤我们采取行动” ____ 

“中日冲突的迅速发展大大缩小了
苏联驻上海领事馆的影响范围。日本帝国军队
正用铁扫帚将共产主义扫除出中国，这使得
当地的苏联代表陷入悲惨境地。上海已成为
白俄活动的开放舞台。现在是我们登场和表演的时候了，
我们必须充分利用这一有利形势 ____ 

“俄罗斯侨民民族意识的增长要求
白俄分子予以表达，要求采取行动。我们
期刊首期的问世，即是这一行动的开始” ____ 

2. 摘自题为《利益冲突之处》的文章

国际上海是许多强国相互冲突的利益交汇之地。
居住在这座城市的俄罗斯流亡者，为了不在这场斗争中
被践踏，无论他们是否愿意，都必须依靠一个能够
保护他们且在关键时刻不会背叛他们的强国。

对于许多俄罗斯人居住的
法租界当局来说，给予他们
这种保护本是顺理成章之事。法俄友谊有着悠久的
传统，俄罗斯流亡者在法国人民中肯定有许多
朋友。但友谊是一回事，法国内阁的政策则是另一回事，
更不用说法国境内粉色和红色分子的态度了。

" The arm of the Comintern has reached Shanghai through the me-
dium of the French communist party and the Popular Front. The
French Consular and Police Authorities in Shanghai have proved
their alliance with the U.S.S.R. by dealing a blow to Russian
emigrants.. making Russian residents of the French Concession
sign bonds to the effect that they will not engage in politics;
registration of Russian emigrants and unlawful levy of registra-
tion fees; deportation of Russian journalist Goostoff and hand-
ing him over to the Chinese authorities at Wenchow for incarce-
ration - all this shows that Russians cannot trust the French
Authorities. Making up a list of persons liable to be deported
in future, introduction of a system of mass searching reminds
every White Russian of the nightmare of life in the U.S.S.R.
where people were put into Black Marias at night time and
taken to places of execution without any trial"....

" In the International Settlement where British in-
fluence predominates, servile lackeys, renegades from the midst
of white Russian emigrants, endeavour through their informers to
penetrate into every white organization in order to obstruct
their activities. It looks, as if here, too, the arm of the Comin-
tern is present. The overzealous servants of the Municipal Po-
lice forget that their primary duty is to struggle against
criminals and not against those who, having been deprived of
their motherland, strive to regain it. Russian emigrants have
not a few friends in the Settlement. The sympathetic attitude
of the British community towards Russian emigrants has been de-
monstrated on more than one occasion, but no one ever said, no
one one ever demanded that Russians should change their politi-
cal views.. Russian emigrants do not infringe law in the Set-

the Municipal Police to introduce registration of Russian news-
papers and organizations? Are Russians really such helpless
children that they need a municipal guardian? When the Settle-
ment and the French Concession were passing through critical
times, Russians were needed for the maintenance of order and
